details.description: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 is Alibaba's July 2025 update to the Qwen3-30B-A3B mixture-of-experts model, dedicated to extended reasoning: the model card states it 'supports only thinking mode' and always produces a reasoning trace before its final answer. It has 30.5B total parameters with 3.3B activated per token across 128 experts (8 active per token). Native context is 262,144 tokens, extendable to 1 million tokens with Dual Chunk Attention. The model card reports gains over the original Qwen3-30B-A3B in mathematics, science, coding and agentic tool-use tasks.
advantages: Scores 85.0 on AIME25, per the model's Hugging Face card.
Scores 73.4 on GPQA, per the model's Hugging Face card.
Scores 80.9 on MMLU-Pro, per the model's Hugging Face card.
Scores 72.4 on the BFCL-v3 tool-calling benchmark, per the model's Hugging Face card.
Scores 66.0 on LiveCodeBench v6, per the model's Hugging Face card.
disadvantages: Runs in thinking mode only; the model always produces a reasoning trace and cannot be switched to a faster non-thinking mode, per the model card.
The extra reasoning step means responses are typically longer than the sibling Instruct-2507 checkpoint, which runs non-thinking only.
use_cases: Complex mathematical and scientific reasoning tasks
Competitive coding tasks, per the model's LiveCodeBench v6 result
Agentic tool-use tasks, per the model's BFCL-v3 result
Long-context reasoning tasks up to 262,144 tokens natively

notes: Catalog's 262,144 max input/output tokens match this model's native context window per Qwen's Hugging Face card; the card recommends a smaller output budget in practice (32,768 tokens for standard queries, up to 81,920 for complex reasoning). Arena-Hard v2 (56.0) and WritingBench (85.0) are reported on the model card but omitted from evaluations as arena/judged-style scores rather than accuracy scores.
